verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a pre-recorded transcription endpoint, a callback URL feature and a CLI, but nothing on running jobs in parallel, concurrency limits or queueing behavior. Callbacks are an adjacent async-delivery feature, not documented concurrency or queueing semantics, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run many transcription jobs in parallel, with concurrency limits and queueing behavior documented
